senses.gloss:
1. स्तृ स्तृ, ii. 5, स्तृणु, and स्तॄ स्तॄ, ii. 9, स्तृणा, णी, Par. Ātm.
 1. To spread, to expand.
 2. To cover, Ragh. 7, 55.
 --Caus. To cover, Bhaṭṭ. 15, 48.
 --With the prep. अव अव, To cover, to fill, Kir. 14, 29.
 --With आ आ,
 1. To spread, MBh. 3, 15142.
 2. To cover, Daśak. in Chr. 179, 15. आस्तरणीय, n. A cover, a carpet, Rām. 5, 11, 19.
 --With समा सम्-आ, To cover (fire with water, i. e. to extinguish), MBh. 1, 1495.
 --With उप उप, ptcple. pf. pass. उपस्तीर्ण, Arranged, MBh. 2, 2033.
 --With परि परि,
 1. To spread, Rām. 3, 49, 9.
 2. To arrange, MBh. 1, 6975.
 3. To cover, Śiś. 9, 18.
 --With प्र प्र, प्रस्तृत, Disappeared.
 --With वि वि, To spread, Man. 1, 51; 7, 33. विस्तृत.
 1. Diffused.
 2. Diffuse.
 3. Wide opened, MBh. 3, 12905.
 4. Broad, Matsyop. 13; ample, Nalod. 3, 14. विस्तीर्ण, Large, great, Pañc. 51, 20; iii. d. 264.
 --Comp.
 --Caus.
 1. To cause to spread, Pañc. 171, 3.
 2. To extend, Man. 7, 188. []
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To spread, MBh. 1, 7163.
 2. To cover, MBh. 2, 1774.
 --Cf. στόρνυμι, στορεύς, στρώννυμι, στλεγγίς; Lat. sternere, strages, struere, stringo; O.H.G. sturm; A.S. stearm, storm; strene, lectus; Goth. straujan; A.S. streowian, sternere; A.S. strion, thesaurus, strionan; O.H.G. sterbjan (old Caus.), interficere, sterban; A.S. stearfian, steorfan, mori; strec; O.H.G. strac; A.S. streccan, a-stregdan, a-strican, probably stregan, stredan; ge-strangian, To strengthen, etc.

3. स्तृ स्तृ, probably 2. अस् + तृ, A star, Chr. 293, 1 = Rigv. i. 87, 1.
 --Cf. ἀστήρ, τεῖρος; Æol. τέῤῥος; Goth. stairno; A.S. steorra; Lat. stella (see तार).
स्तॄ स्तॄ, see स्तृ; स्तॄह् स्तॄह्, see स्तृह्.
स्तृक्ष् स्तृक्ष्, i. 1. Par. To go.
† स्तृह् स्तृह्, स्तॄह् स्तृह्, i. 6, Par. To hurt, to kill.
